explanation: Mandarin's four tones, plus a light neutral one, make ma mean mother, hemp, horse or scold. Cantonese, spoken in Hong Kong and Guangdong, uses six, or nine by a traditional count.

claims.text: Standard Mandarin has four tones, plus a neutral tone.
Cantonese has six tones, or nine in a traditional count that includes the checked tones.
In Mandarin, the syllable ma in its four tones can mean mother, hemp, horse or scold.
Cantonese is spoken in Hong Kong and Guangdong.
